current_methods.R52: 6000 x 3375 reconstruction of the trailer framing using P45 scene and relocated Vex pixels. AI reconstructs the S52 title and exposed wall. Title matte pinholes and the C aperture were repaired using the registered scene beneath. This is a derivative, not an original high-resolution titled release.

limitations: The title is an AI reconstruction of the small trailer reference, not the original high-resolution logo; fine cracks and shading are inferred.
The wall behind the relocated Vex is locally reconstructed; fine concealed geometry cannot be confirmed from the sources.
initial_reconstruction_evidence_scope: The record below describes the initial output hashes and methods before this quality revision. Its pixel-preservation assertions do not apply to the revised outputs above.

initial_reconstruction.vex_source: Original P45 scene pixels extracted through a segmented matte.
initial_reconstruction.title_source: AI reconstruction of S52 logo; text checked against the trailer reference.
initial_reconstruction.background_patch: Restricted to the vacated Vex silhouette with a small blend.
visual_checks: Full composition and title text compared with S52.
Moved Vex close-up checked for duplicated sword fragments; original dark sword outline restored to the matte.
Reconstructed title background fringe removed and inspected.
Source scene supplies the high-resolution frame; hidden wall reconstruction is locally masked.
